name: Wells, Groundwater Extraction, Depletion & Contamination Runtime
design_rules: well yield depends on water table, well reach and extraction capacity
extraction removes stored groundwater and can lower the water table
recharge can recover depleted aquifers over time
spring and wetland support decline when groundwater falls below thresholds
contamination enters groundwater through infiltration rather than appearing globally
contaminants move and decay according to contaminant-specific properties
well protection reduces but does not magically eliminate contamination risk
groundwater extraction and contamination persist across world days
groundwater use never uses emissive or glow feedback
